name: The (BW) rule
summary: The second new axiom of the Jeandel–Perdrix–Vilmart Clifford+T axiomatisation: a single-qubit identity between two diagrams with π/4 phase gadgets.
description:
This is the second of the two axioms that Jeandel, Perdrix and Vilmart added to obtain the first complete axiomatisation of the Clifford+T ZX-calculus (the other one is [commutation of controls](../commutation-of-controls/)). Unlike (C) it is specific to the $\frac\pi4$ angle. Like (C) it arose from the translation between the ZX- and ZW-calculi used in the completeness proof, and the authors remark that it is "hardly understandable as is".

Both sides are single-qubit maps built from Clifford+T phases and small phase gadgets with $\frac\pi4$ phases. No derivation of (BW) from the earlier axioms was known when it was introduced.
